environment.description: CI/CD report generator service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing listener on port 443. The ALB target group routes directly to the container on port 8080. No WAF is attached. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and inbound 8080 from the ALB security group on the ECS tasks. The service is accessible to any authenticated CI/CD user via API key passed in X-Api-Key header (validated at ALB level via Lambda authorizer that accepts any non-empty key).

config.load_balancer: ALB with public listener, no WAF
config.auth: Lambda authorizer accepting any non-empty X-Api-Key
